statements.impact_statement: This exact locally built package contains only libz from upstream zlib 1.3.2 (SHA256 bb329a0a2cd0274d05519d61c667c062e06990d72e125ee2dfa8de64f0119d16). MiniZip is not compiled or installed. CVE-2023-45853 affects MiniZip through zlib 1.3. Trivy's Debian bookworm source-package advisory has no fixed version, so it also flags this newer locally built binary package. References: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2023-45853 and https://github.com/madler/zlib/releases/tag/v1.3.2 . This statement does not apply to other package versions or MiniZip packages.
